description.narrative: El objetivo general del Programa es contribuir al desarrollo sostenible de las entidades federativas de Mxico mediante el fortalecimiento de su capacidad de planificacin, de gestin fiscal y de inversiones, as como a travs del diseo e implementacin de proyectos de inversin, en un marco de sostenibilidad fiscal de mediano y largo plazo.

The overall program objective is to contribute to sustainable development in the states of Mexico by strengthening their capacity for planning, fiscal management and investment, as well as through the design and implementation of investment projects within a framework of fiscal sustainability in the medium and long term.
